[[File:Elemental amulet detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''elemental amulet''' is an amulet requiring level 59 [[Magic]] to equip. It is made by combining the [[Amulet of air|amulets of air]], [[Amulet of water|water]], [[Amulet of earth|earth]], and [[Amulet of fire|fire]] at any [[Runic_altar#Elemental|elemental runic altar]]. Doing so requires level 30 [[Runecraft]] and 500 of each elemental [[Runes|rune]], granting 175 experience. It can also be created when accessing the altars via [[Guardians of the Rift]], as they are the same altars as outside the minigame.

Creating each of the aforementioned amulets requires 100 runes of the corresponding element and its associated [[elemental gem]] ([[air diamond]], [[water sapphire]], [[earth emerald]], or [[fire ruby]]) to be brought to their respective elemental runic altars.

The elemental amulet combines the effects of all four amulets, adding a max-hit bonus of +2 to all [[elemental spells]], which is added before [[magic damage]] and [[elemental weakness]] modifiers are applied, and therefore scales with both. This bonus stacks additively with the +2 bonus of elemental fragments from [[The Fractured Archive#Rewards|the Fractured Archive]], for a total max-hit bonus of +4. It also stacks additively with the +3 max-hit bonus of [[chaos gauntlets]], for a maximum possible bonus of +7 to [[bolt spells]].
